selection_rules.kmeans: Maximize silhouette on the same fixed training sample; break exact ties by smaller training Davies-Bouldin index, then smaller k.
selection_rules.dbscan: Eligible: at least 2 and at most 20 nonnoise clusters, coverage>=0.50, all nonnoise clusters>=30, defined conditional silhouette. Maximize coverage*conditional silhouette; tie by higher coverage, lower DBI, smaller eps, smaller min_samples. This heuristic is not directly compared with KMeans silhouette. If no candidate is eligible, retain the prespecified m10/Q85 candidate as an explicitly unsuccessful density comparison.
selection_rules.primary_algorithm: KMeans is the prespecified full-coverage operational segmentation; DBSCAN is a separate density/noise diagnostic, not declared superior using a conditional metric.
selection_rules.weak_structure: Flag KMeans silhouette<0.25 or minimum pairwise seed ARI<0.80; do not keep searching or rename weak clusters as confirmed segments.
selection_rules.dbscan_validation: Apply only fitted training cores. Within eps choose the nearest core; exact distance ties use the smallest original training row index. If no core is reachable use -1. Ambiguous means reachable cores belong to at least two training clusters.

interpretation.features: Static tenure, current fees, subscription breadth, contract and billing profile; not actual activity recency or frequency. Three numerical columns use train-fitted z scaling; binary flags remain 0/1; each categorical one-hot block is divided by sqrt(2).
interpretation.value: Current monthly-fee proxy in dataset fee units per month; not profit, CLV, future realized revenue or a calibrated expected loss.
interpretation.priority: Frozen model p times MonthlyCharges is a scenario ranking weight, not intervention benefit, ROI or verified expected revenue loss.
interpretation.rfm: Unavailable: no last activity/transaction date and no activity or transaction count. No R or F is invented.
interpretation.risk: p>=0.30 is high risk; the opposite side is non-high risk and includes the prior low and medium bands. No policy threshold is retuned.
